note: Justin 10-14 要求 DI / Stera 优先：顺序 C8 → C7 → C9 → C2。每日迭代按顺序取第一个 status=ready 的候选提交到 Kaggle（同时最多 1 个 GPU kernel；不抢占正在跑的）。跑完把结果写进 ledger.csv 并把 status 改成 done_*。

stera_batches.note: 172 sessions (smallest-first, 39.8 GB raw annotations) converted in 5 batches; raw deleted. b01 = 59 sessions, 757 moving segs, 225,863 frames = 4.2 h. b02–b05 (+14.3 h) staged at /workspace/sd/stera_unified on the box; add as new dataset versions in later loop iterations.

queue.name: stera all batches, QC-passed only

qc.eval: LOO over the 2 passing depth clips (08-22_18-21, 08-24_21-18); not directly comparable to 3-clip numbers, compare vs zero within run

queue.note: Kernel v1 was pushed by mistake WITHOUT QC filter (all 3584 segs) and is running; treat as unfiltered control. QC version must be pushed when a GPU slot frees (Kaggle max 2 batch GPU sessions).

stera_batches.note: dataset xhey-stera-pretrain now holds all 5 batches + qc/*/scorecards.json

queue.name: DI pretrain, camera frame (rerun of C8)
queue.protocol: same as C10: LOO over 3 depth clips, seeds 3, pre-steps 6000, steps 3000, move-cm 5, --no-final; arm A xhey_c11 (iphone+di+xhey_rgb+aug, --qc-filter DI scorecards) then same-code control arm B xhey_c11ctl (iphone+xhey_rgb+aug). Ingest arm A from xhey_c11/metrics.json; compare to xhey_c11ctl and zero within run.

qc.frame: DI converter camera_yup -> camera optical via common.frames.canonicalize_for_xhey; sanity_check ok 25/25 (wrist z>0, median dist 0.35 m)

result.note: DI (camera frame) did not beat the no-DI control; ingested 2026-10-15 as C11 / C11ctl, charts in experiments/report/C11_vs_ctl
